items.source: Although the marshal method accepts a java.lang.Object as its first parameter, most Marshaller implementations cannot handle arbitrary Objects. Instead, an object class must be registered with the marshaller, or have a common base class.
items.translation: 尽管 `marshal` 方法接受一个 `java.lang.Object` 作为其第一个参数，但大多数 `Marshaller` 实现无法处理任意的 `Object`。相反，必须向 marshaller 注册对象类，或者使用一个共同的基类。

items.source: Marshal the object graph with the given root into the provided Result.
items.translation: 将给定根的对象图反序列化为提供的 Result。

items.source: Indicate whether this marshaller can marshal instances of the supplied type.
items.translation: 指示该转换器是否可以序列化所供应类型的实例。

items.source: true if this marshaller can indeed marshal instances of the supplied class; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此序列化器确实可以序列化提供的类的实例；否则为 false。

items.source: IOException - if an I/O error occurs
items.translation: IOException - 如果发生 I/O 错误

items.source: XmlMappingException - if the given object cannot be marshalled to the result
items.translation: XmlMappingException - 如果给定对象无法被反序列化为结果

items.source: clazz - the class that this marshaller is being asked if it can marshal
items.translation: clazz - 该类被要求判断此序列化器是否可以对其进行序列化。

items.source: graph - the root of the object graph to marshal
